rules.hospital: OpenStreetMap features tagged amenity=hospital. Tier 1 = named as a hospital (Bệnh viện …, … Hospital); tier 0 = everything else tagged as a hospital (district health centres, commune health stations, clinics that mappers tagged as hospitals). Beds and operator are kept where mapped. Duplicates (same name within 0.5 km) are merged.
rules.university: OpenStreetMap features tagged amenity=university or amenity=college (campuses, not institutions: a university with several campuses appears several times). Duplicates (same name within 0.5 km) are merged.
rules.market: OpenStreetMap features tagged amenity=marketplace. Duplicates (same name within 0.5 km) are merged.
rules.worship: OpenStreetMap features tagged amenity=place_of_worship, grouped by their religion tag: Buddhist (chùa), Christian (Catholic and Protestant churches), Cao Đài, Hòa Hảo, Muslim, Hindu, Vietnamese and Chinese folk religion (đình, đền, miếu, family halls) and other. A place without a religion tag is classed by the first words of its name (Chùa → Buddhist, Nhà thờ → Christian but Nhà thờ họ → folk, Thánh thất → Cao Đài, Đình/Đền/Miếu/Phủ → folk), else other.
rules.beach: OpenStreetMap features tagged natural=beach that have a name.
rules.protected: OpenStreetMap areas tagged boundary=protected_area or leisure=nature_reserve whose mapped outline covers at least 10 km², except national parks (boundary=national_park, protect_class 2, or a name starting “Vườn quốc gia”) and World Heritage sites (heritage:operator=whc): those are wonders already. Area is the outline's area (outer rings minus inner rings).
rules.relic: Every special national relic (di tích quốc gia đặc biệt) in the Vietnamese Wikipedia list, which follows the Prime Minister's ranking decisions (one per round). Placed at the coordinates given in the list, else at the coordinates of the relic's own Wikipedia article (GeoData, else its Wikidata item), else a named OpenStreetMap historic feature or place of worship whose name contains the relic's name or article title (at least two words; all matches within 5 km of each other); the last three only when they fall within 3 km of the province the list names (former or 2025 name). Relics that none of these places are left off the map (listed in unplaced).
rules.metro: OpenStreetMap urban rail: route relations route=subway or light_rail (both directions merged by line), drawn along the ways railway=subway / light_rail they use; named rail ways outside any route (depot spurs and test tracks excluded) are lines of their own when 3 km or longer. Length is one direction's mapped track. Only lines that are mapped as rail are shown; lines under construction are tagged differently and are not included.
rules.bridge: OpenStreetMap road ways tagged bridge=* on expressways, national and primary roads (highway=motorway, trunk, primary and their links), named by bridge:name or a name starting “Cầu” or containing “Bridge”. Ways with the same name within 2 km are one bridge; its length is the straight distance between its farthest mapped ends. Bridges 500 m or longer are kept.
rules.schools_lens: OpenStreetMap features tagged amenity=school, counted per hex.
